bullets.text: Engineered a high-throughput data processing pipeline in Python using Pandas and AsyncIO, reducing batch processing latency by 45% across distributed storage clusters.
Integrated REST APIs with strict Pydantic JSON schema validation and Redis caching, cutting redundant database queries by 85% during peak load testing.
Automated campus device provisioning by writing Bash and Python scripts, reducing manual setup time per machine from 45 minutes to under 5 minutes.
Implemented a fault-tolerant distributed key-value store in Go utilizing the Raft consensus algorithm, guaranteeing linearizable read/write operations during node failures.
Designed high-performance gRPC interfaces backed by embedded LevelDB storage, achieving 12,000+ operations per second in multi-node Docker benchmark simulations.
Architected an in-memory vector search engine utilizing HNSW graph indexing for fast approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval across 500K+ high-dimensional embeddings.
Exposed async search endpoints via FastAPI with comprehensive Pytest coverage, delivering sub-15ms vector query latencies under concurrent load.
Built a responsive task management dashboard in React 19 featuring drag-and-drop Kanban boards, real-time status synchronization, and custom Tailwind styling.
